resources.string: ManhwaLens draws its floating button and the capture view on top of any app. Android requires your explicit overlay permission for this.
A draggable lens button that stays on top of other apps. Tap it to capture the current frame and view the Arabic translation in place.
Grant the overlay permission first, then flip this switch.
Translation engine, Arabic font size, auto-capture, privacy policy
Applies the next time a capture overlay opens.
No capture to review yet — tap the lens on a page first.
What a single tap on the floating lens does. Capture permission is always requested first when no session is active.

After every tap on the lens, show a small dismissible panel with the status of each pipeline stage (tap, consent, capture, OCR, filter, translate, overlay). The same trace is saved to Last error. Also saves the last frame with the OCR boxes drawn on it.

Twelve stages of the Live pipeline, refreshed every second: PASS / FAIL / WAIT. If Live does not translate, the first FAIL line is where it stopped. "Copy report" adds the last 60 log lines (API keys removed) — paste it in a bug report.
Live self-check report copied to the clipboard.
No data yet — turn the floating lens on, switch Live ON and open a page. This screen fills in within a second.
No debug capture saved yet — enable debug mode and tap the lens once.
Written automatically when something crashes, and replaced by the latest pipeline trace after every tap. Copy it and share it when reporting a bug.

Optional extra trigger — NOT required. Live mode follows the scroll on its own; this switch only pokes a capture the moment you stop scrolling, via the read-only accessibility service (never reads screen content). Needs an armed capture session: tap the lens once first.
Reports when you finish scrolling so ManhwaLens can capture the visible page. Never reads screen content.
ManhwaLens could not stay on top: %1$s
Capture consent was not usable — please try again
Default: gemini-3.8-flash. If the selected model is retired (HTTP 404), the other one is tried automatically and saved.
No models supporting generateContent were found for this key.
Remote translation unavailable — used the on-device engine.
What ManhwaLens reads, keeps and sends. English and العربية.

Frames are captured and processed on your device for OCR and bubble detection. With ML Kit selected, translation stays on-device.

With Gemini selected, recognized bubble text is sent to Google using your API key; screenshots are not sent for text translation. The key stays in app-private storage and is sent in an HTTP header.

With LibreTranslate selected, recognized text is sent in one batch over HTTPS to the server URL you configured; the optional server key is sent in the JSON request body. ManhwaLens does not operate that server. Use an endpoint you trust.

If experimental AI cleanup is enabled, cropped images of up to three bubbles may be sent to Gemini for image editing.

The text-only translation cache is stored in app-private memory and storage and can be cleared in Settings. No analytics or telemetry are sent; ManhwaLens has no accounts or translation server.
Free and fully offline after a one-time model download (~30 MB). Nothing leaves your phone.
Much better colloquial Arabic and context across bubbles. Requires your own API key.
Open-source engine you control. One batched request runs beside the on-device draft; configure a trusted HTTPS server.
Only OCR text is sent (never screenshots). URL and optional key are stored on this device; use a server you trust. HTTPS is required.
The key is stored only on this device (app-private storage) and sent to Google solely as an HTTP header. It never appears in logs or in the app source.
Translates a sample two-line page with the selected engine and shows the raw result.
No translation — see metrics/test result above
No English text detected in this frame
Capture ready · tap the lens to grab a frame
ManhwaLens running · tap the lens to capture
ManhwaLens could not stay on top — check the notification and try again
Gemini paused for 5 minutes — translated offline. Tap "Retry Gemini" in Settings to retry now.
After a failure (%1$s), ML Kit offline translation is used for ~%2$s min, then Gemini resumes automatically.
Gemini re-enabled — it will be tried on the next capture
Watch the screen at ~3 fps. While you scroll, overlays hide; when the page settles it is translated automatically. Auto-armed by your first lens tap. Long-press the floating button to pause/resume.
Comma-separated package names, e.g. com.brave.browser,com.android.chrome. Empty = everywhere. Needs usage-access permission to detect the foreground app.
Live mode ON — long-press the button to turn off
Live mode paused to save battery (5 min without page changes) — it resumes automatically when the page changes
Live mode needs screen capture — tap the lens button once to grant it
Blocks fully inside the top / bottom edge bands are never translated — they are usually browser chrome, not manhwa. Default: 8% each.
Translation failed — details in the window
Frame is nearly black · this app may block capture (FLAG_SECURE)
Live mode armed — translation follows the scroll. Long-press the button to pause.
How long the page must be still before it is translated (200–1000 ms, default 400).
How much the frame must change to count as scrolling/animation. High reacts to subtle changes (e.g. a blinking cursor).

Live mode does NOT need the accessibility service. This switch only adds an extra trigger that pokes a capture the moment you stop scrolling. On sideloaded apps Android blocks the service as a “Restricted setting”, so it stays Off — allow it first, or just leave it off and rely on Live mode.
Sideloaded app: open App info → three-dot menu (⋮) → “Allow restricted settings”, then Accessibility → ManhwaLens → On.

One line per name: English = عربي. The dictionary already holds ~250 Chinese names and cultivation terms; your lines win over it and are applied before the engine sees the text, so every bubble spells the name the same way.
Joins the lines of the same bubble before translating, so a sentence that wraps onto two lines is translated as one sentence (recommended).

One phrase per line (or comma-separated), case-insensitive. Blocks containing any phrase are skipped before translation. Pre-filled with common site chrome: Subscribe, Get the app, Continue Reading, TOP, Episode, views, coins. Clear the field to disable.

Translates the same 20 sentences with the on-device ML Kit engine (offline): one by one, in parallel (2/3/4/6 at once) and as one joined call with 8 different separators. 5 passes each, first one discarded; shows median and worst time and whether every bubble maps back. Takes about a minute. The result is also added to the self-check \"Copy report\".
The app crashed twice at startup, so it launched without the floating button, translation and Live mode. Your settings were left untouched. Tap below to retry normally.
Safe Mode is on — exit it from the red banner first

After a tap-translate, send only the ≤3 largest bubble crops to Gemini and swap in an Arabic-rendered bubble it draws. Local patches remain if anything fails. Cloud-only, one attempt per bubble, 15 s timeout.
Save a Gemini key above to enable AI cleanup.
This account reports no image-capable models. AI cleanup will use the local patch.
Your bubble image is sent to Google with the translated Arabic. Nothing else leaves the device.
AI cleanup on — next tap-translate will try Gemini for the largest bubbles
No pipeline trace recorded yet. Translate a page first.
This is the same trace that used to appear in the floating debug panel. Copy it to share with support.
Names are remembered per series and stay on this device. Locked names always win, even over a cached translation.
No series selected — names are not saved
Select or create a series first. Names are only stored inside a series, so one story never reuses another one’s spelling.
No characters remembered yet. Translate a page of this series and they will appear here.
